originalTitle: Groww responds to Nithin Kamath tweet: Direct mutual funds remain free for DIY investors
simplifiedContent: Groww, an investment platform, wants to reassure its users that they can still buy direct mutual funds without paying any extra fees. This means that people who manage their own investments (called "do-it-yourself" or DIY investors) won't have to pay anything to use the platform for mutual funds. Groww is promising to keep this service free, which is good news for its users. This announcement comes after some recent discussions about how mutual funds are being sold in the market. Groww is trying to clarify that its policy of not charging DIY investors for mutual funds hasn't changed.

originalTitle: Sebi cancels registration of 12 research analysts over unpaid renewal fees
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market regulator, Sebi, has cancelled the registrations of 12 research analysts because they didn't pay their renewal fees. This means they can no longer work as research analysts. Sebi had sent them notices, but they didn't respond or pay the fees, so Sebi took action. This matters because research analysts provide important information to help investors make decisions, and Sebi wants to ensure they follow the rules. By cancelling their registrations, Sebi is holding them accountable for not paying their fees.

originalTitle: Costco shares fall over 4% as investors look past strong June sales
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with Costco's stock: the company had strong sales in June, but its stock price still went down by over 4%. This might seem surprising, but investors are looking beyond the good sales numbers and are worried about how much the company's stock is worth (its "valuation"). They're also concerned that sales weren't great in all areas, like Canada, which is making them skeptical. This is causing investors to be more careful when it comes to expensive consumer stocks like Costco's.

originalTitle: HDFC Bank Q1 results date: Private lender to announce June quarter earnings on 18 July
simplifiedContent: HDFC Bank, a major private bank, will announce its earnings for the quarter ending June on July 18. This means the bank will share how well it performed financially during the months of April, May, and June. The bank's Board of Directors will meet on July 18 to review and approve the financial results. This is important because it will give investors an idea of how the bank is doing and help them decide whether to invest or not. On July 18, investors can expect to learn about the bank's financial performance and any other important updates.

originalTitle: Russia's largest private lender Alfa Bank tests crypto trading, plans suite of crypto services ahead of govt legislation
simplifiedContent: Alfa Bank, a big bank in Russia, is trying out a new feature that lets people buy and sell cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin on its investment app. The bank also wants to offer more services related to cryptocurrencies in the future. This is happening before the Russian government makes official rules about digital assets like cryptocurrencies. This matters because it shows that a major bank is interested in cryptocurrency, which could make it more accessible to regular people. The bank's move is likely a way to get ready for when the government does make those rules, so it can be one of the first to offer these services.

originalTitle: Multibagger defence stock Apollo Micro Systems to be in focus on Friday; here's why
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, is making a big move by buying a large part of another company called Premier Explosives. They're spending ₹1,550 crore to buy 41.33% of Premier Explosives, which will help India's defense capabilities. This deal might make Apollo Micro Systems' stock more interesting to investors on Friday. The company plans to maybe buy even more shares of Premier Explosives as part of the deal, and everything should be finished by December 2026. This deal is important because it could affect the value of Apollo Micro Systems' stock.
